expected_reasoning: Pivot v2 excludes speech, music/score, applause, and generic noise from passing the non-speech-audio prescreen.
reviewer_task: Mark speech as dominant and transcriptive substitution risk as high.
Do not treat the faint background event as answer-bearing without a concrete local fact.
Use NO_GO when the candidate depends on speech rather than source-world non-speech audio.
scenario: An interval is dominated by intelligible speech while a faint background click or hum is also audible.
title: Speech-dominated interval
